item.title: [SwiftHFR] Reader: drop HFR's signature separator, one thin line (#755)
item.body:
Closes #755 Claim: mac/i755 ### Problem With « Afficher les signatures » on, each signature is preceded by HFR's row of dashes (« --------------- ») on top of the reader's own border line (operator, device test 2026-11-11). ### Cause HFR opens every `span.signature` with its own separator: a space, 15 dashes, a line break, then `
` (capture `R267a`, #267, merged in #764). LOT-034 kept it as signature text; legacy removed it (`LinkItem.m:74` @ `87fe0d1c`, every 15-dash string of the message). `.signature` in `reader.css` already drew a 1px dashed top border, so the two added up. ### Change - `MessageContentNormalizer` (LOT-034): the signature HTML drops the separator at its start (leading spaces, exactly 15 dashes, the whitespace after). Nothing else: dashes in the body, or inside the signature after its first text, stay. This differs from legacy on purpose (the issue asks for it): legacy also deleted a member's own 15-dash line. - `reader.css`: `.signature` keeps legacy's `1px dashed` line (`style-liste-light.css:79`, `style-liste-dark.css:45` @ `87fe0d1c`) in the theme's `var(--separator)` (THEMES.md §3). Only the dashes text goes away. - Docs: LOT-034 (differences 8 and its mentions) and HFR-PROTOCOL updated: the separator is captured (R267a) and dropped only at the start of a signature. ### Tests (red first) - `MessageSignatureSeparatorTests` (HFRKit, 4 tests): `R267a` (all 9 signatures lose the separator, keep "Signature removed."), a body line of dashes is kept, own dashes after the signature's first text are kept (both hand-built fragments, marked as such: the capture has none, #755 comment), a signature without separator is untouched. Seen failing without the change (3 of 4). - `SignatureLineWebTests` (app, real `WKWebView` on `R267a`): no dashes in the signature, computed `border-top` is `dashed` / `1px`, as wide as the message text. Seen failing without the change (dashes present; the line was already dashed, so only the dashes check fails). - `SignatureLineWebTests` also checks `borderTopColor` equals the theme separator in light and dark (fails with `lightgray`); 14 and 16 dash runs and a separator-only signature are tested (hand-built; the 16-dash test fails without the guard). - Full app suite on one simulator: 1348 tests, all pass (round 2). HFRParsingTests: 522 tests, one timing test (`HFRBBCodeWriterTests` scan-time ratio) failed under machine load, unrelated. Screenshots (fixture text only): before/after, light/dark, in `~/agent-work/.../lots/755/` (sig-after2-*.png after, sig-before-*.png before). ### Ledger ```changelog | T | La signature n'est plus précédée des 15 tirets de HFR (seuls ceux-là, pas les tirets tapés par un membre). | LOT-034 #755 | `LinkItem.m:74` @ `87fe0d1c`, capture R267a | ``` ```gap-edit GAP-054 SwiftHFR final: Same setting, off by default. HFR's 15-dash separator before a signature is dropped (only that one; legacy removed every occurrence in the message) and nothing else changes. Gap: ported with changes ``` 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_014QH2CJ1auuPWv2FeT7Q4Ps

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5), round 1 on efadfee0: REQUEST CHANGES** 1. **Medium**: `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Resources/reader.css:143`. The rule was already `1px dashed`. The only CSS change is the colour, from `var(--separator)` to the literal `lightgray`, and that goes against #755 Scope 3 ("the separator colour of the theme, in light and dark") and THEMES.md §3 (`separator`, "one definition, #572"). - Failing scenario: in dark mode the line goes from #38383a (or the darker/OLED `--app-dark-separator`, at the user's brightness) to a fixed #d3d3d3. It ignores the theme and the dimming. In light mode, #d1d1d6 and #d3d3d3 look the same, so the change only shows in dark. - The quoted operator sentence is not on the issue or the PR. - `SignatureLineWebTests` checks only the style and width, so reverting to `var(--separator)` stays green: the colour change has no test. - Fix: restore `var(--separator)`. If the operator wants a fixed lightgray, record that decision on #755 (its scope also says "solid"), add a test on `borderTopColor`, and say how it fits THEMES.md. 2. **Medium**: stale docs (L08/L09). `docs/lots/LOT-034-content-normalization.md:16,139,192` still says the separator is "not ported" / "not deleted" (Intentional differences 8). `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:373` still lists the separator under "Not in the corpus", which is false since R267a. Fix: update both in this PR. 3. **Low**: `MessageContentNormalizer.swift:130`. The guard that keeps a longer run of dashes is untested. Mutation check: I deleted the guard and all 10 tests of the two suites stayed green. Fix: add a hand-built fragment test, marked as such: 16 dashes kept (and 14). 4. **Detail**: a signature made only of the separator gives `signatureHTML == "
"` (my probe), so the reader shows an empty block with a line. Legacy did the same (`span.signature` is `display:block` with a border) and the case is not captured, so a note in the LOT-034 spec is enough. 5. **Detail**: the changelog row has a stray space before the full stop: "membre) .". **Verified** - Legacy at 87fe0d1c: - `LinkItem.m:74` removes every `---------------`. - The `1px dashed lightgray` rule is at `style-liste-light.css:79` and `style-liste-dark.css:45` (also in `style-liste.css` and `-oled.css`). - Probes on the normalizer: - Separator removed: CRLF, no leading space, `
`, 15 dashes as `-` entities. - Kept as is: 16 or 14 dashes, dashes inside ``, a separator after ` `. - Body dashes are untouched. The function is pure and the typed throws are unchanged. `MessageContent` is not persisted. - `ledger.py check-body`: 2 blocks ok. GAP-054 edit: the Gap value is valid. - HFRKit `swift test --filter HFRParsingTests`: 521/521 green (520 plus my probe file). - Two runs under very heavy machine load failed only on wall-clock timing checks, not on this PR: one confirmed in `HFRBBCodeWriterTests.swift:223`, the other run's two failures not identified. - **App suite not run**: on the shared Mac (load average about 960) the simulator test launch failed (Mach -308, "server died"). The web test still needs a run. **Orchestrator decision on finding 1 (mac/m4-captures, 2026-11-11):** the operator asked for legacy's *thin line* (device feedback: « la ligne fine de séparation de l'app legacy est très bien »). Legacy draws it `1px dashed`, which this PR keeps. The colour stays the theme's `var(--separator)`, as #755 scope 3 and THEMES.md §3 say: a fixed `lightgray` would be bright in dark mode and would ignore the theme. Revert the colour and add a `borderTopColor` test. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Round 2 on 56aa5333: 1. Fixed: colour back to `var(--separator)`, `1px dashed` kept, comment cites legacy's rule and THEMES.md §3. New `theLineTakesTheThemesSeparatorColour` (light and dark) fails with `lightgray` (seen red). 2. Fixed: LOT-034 (:16, :139, :192 → difference 8) and HFR-PROTOCOL:373 updated. 3. Fixed: 14 and 16 dash tests (hand-built); the 16 fails with the guard removed (seen red; 14 passes either way, by the prefix check). 4. Fixed: separator-only signature tested (`
`) and noted in LOT-034 difference 8. 5. Fixed: stray space in the changelog row; `check-body` ok. Tests: full app suite 1348/1348 on one simulator. HFRParsingTests 522: all pass except an unrelated scan-time ratio test (`HFRBBCodeWriterTests`) that tripped under machine load. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5), round 2 on 56aa5333: APPROVE** Round-1 findings, checked against `git diff efadfee0 56aa5333`: 1. **Colour (Medium), fixed.** - `reader.css:143` is back to `1px dashed var(--separator)`, following the orchestrator's decision. - The new `theLineTakesTheThemesSeparatorColour(style:)` compares `borderTopColor` with a probe element that resolves `var(--separator)`, in light and in dark. - I checked that the dark case really runs in dark. I added `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .signature { border-top-color: lightgray } }` and the dark argument failed: `rgb(211, 211, 211)` against `rgb(56, 56, 58)`. The light argument still passed. 2. **Docs (Medium), fixed.** The LOT-034 spec's table row `:74`, its pending-capture line and Intentional differences 8 now describe the new behaviour. `HFR-PROTOCOL.md:373` no longer lists the separator as missing from the corpus. 3. **14/16 dashes (Low), fixed.** `otherRunsKept(count:)` covers both runs. - I removed the `after.first != "-"` guard again and the 16-dash case went red (`MessageSignatureSeparatorTests.swift:55`). - The author's reasoning on 14 is right: `hasPrefix` already rejects 14 dashes, so that case passes with or without the guard. It only guards against a looser rule later. 4. **Signature with only the separator (Detail), fixed.** It is recorded in LOT-034 Intentional differences 8 and pinned by the `separatorOnly` test (`"
"`, hand-built, marked as not captured). 5. **Changelog row (Detail), fixed.** The stray space before the full stop is gone. `ledger.py check-body --file` on the current body: 2 blocks ok. No new findings. The new test fragments are marked as hand-built, as LESSONS 36 requires. **Verified** - HFRKit `swift test --filter HFRParsingTests` at 56aa5333: 522/522 passed. - Two mutation runs (guard removed; a dark-only lightgray rule), described above. - `SignatureLineWebTests` on one iOS 27.0 simulator, `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO`, with the 1-minute load average under 60 at launch: xcresult `totalTestCount` 2, both passed. The parameterized test ran both its light and dark arguments. - I did not run the full app suite myself. The author's 1348/0 run was not reproduced here. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
